title: Fined for riding without a helmet
triggers: police took my licence for helmet
helmet nahi pehna tha challan kat gaya

rights.plain_explanation: Everyone above four years of age riding or sitting on a two-wheeler must wear a helmet. A Sikh wearing a turban is exempt.
Not wearing a helmet is fined ₹1,000, and the licence can be disqualified for three months.
For a helmet offence, police may seize your licence to send for disqualification. They must give you a written acknowledgement.

do_now: Accept the challan calmly; this one is lawful.
Ask for the official e-challan or receipt, and an acknowledgement if your licence is taken.
Pay online through the official challan and keep the receipt.
user_at_fault_cases: Riding without a helmet, or carrying a pillion rider (above four years old) without one, is against the law. The fine and possible licence suspension are legal.

escalation.label: Pay the challan officially
escalation.detail: Pay on the Virtual Courts portal or the method printed on the challan, never in cash without a receipt.
